result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: a restaurant card in the “Popular right now” section has a broken/missing image shown as a grey placeholder. One minor edge-clipping artifact is visible in the horizontal category filter row.

issues.description: The large “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” card under “Popular right now” shows a grey placeholder with a broken image icon instead of the restaurant/food photo.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image URL is valid and loads reliably; add a branded fallback image or hide/replace the card until media loads, and avoid showing the system broken-image icon in production.

issues.description: The rightmost category filter chip is partially cut off at the screen edge, making the filter row look abruptly clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding, a fade/scroll indicator, or ensure the last visible chip is intentionally partially shown with clearer scroll affordance.
